profile.summary: Family Engagement Lab is a nonprofit that researches and builds ways for schools and families to work together on student learning. Its main program, FASTalk (Families & Schools Talk), gives schools and districts family learning resources, communication routines and implementation support that connect classroom lessons with learning at home.
